chronicle.kicker.text: UTES timeline · scroll to zoom from eras to hours
chronicle.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title; UTES is the name of the project's time scale, keep it as is

chronicle.title.note: Page title: the timeline of events

chronicle.loading.note: Loading message while the timeline loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

chronicle.zoom.all.note: Button: zoom the timeline out to show every event

chronicle.zoom.day.note: Button: zoom the timeline to the day of the selected event

chronicle.zoom.event.note: Button: zoom the timeline to the selected event

chronicle.bar_title.note: Tooltip of an event on the timeline: its title, start and end dates, and the uncertainty of its timing relative to its anchor, e.g. '± 2 h'

chronicle.month_year.note: Timeline axis label: an abbreviated month and a year, e.g. 'Mar 870 BCE'

chronicle.day_month.note: Timeline axis and day dial label: a two-digit day and an abbreviated month, e.g. '14 Mar'

chronicle.event.title.note: Panel title: details of the selected event

chronicle.event.starts.note: Field label: when the event starts

chronicle.event.ends.note: Field label: when the event ends

chronicle.event.anchor.note: Field label: the event or fixed date this event's timing is measured from

chronicle.anchor_point.start.note: Which end of the anchor event the timing is measured from: its start; shown in brackets after the anchor

chronicle.anchor_point.end.note: Which end of the anchor event the timing is measured from: its end; shown in brackets after the anchor

chronicle.event.precision.note: Field label: how precisely the event can be dated (year, day, hour…)

chronicle.event.text_says.note: Field label: the year as the biblical text states it, e.g. 'in the third year'

chronicle.event.season.note: Field label: the season the text mentions

chronicle.event.hour.note: Field label: the time of day the text mentions

chronicle.event.verses.note: Field label: the verses that narrate the event

chronicle.dial.title.note: Panel title: a 24-hour clock face showing the events of one day

chronicle.dial.note.text: Events of this civil day. Cyan dots mark the ancient hours: dawn, morning, noon, minchah, evening.
chronicle.dial.note.note: Caption under the 24-hour dial; minchah is the Hebrew name of the afternoon offering hour

chronicle.hour.ashmoret_haboker.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of the morning watch, the last watch of the night (about 2 a.m.); tooltip on the day dial

chronicle.hour.shachar.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of dawn (about 5:30 a.m.)

chronicle.hour.boker.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of morning (about 6 a.m.)

chronicle.hour.third_hour.note: The third hour of the day, counted from sunrise (about 9 a.m.)

chronicle.hour.minchah.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of the afternoon offering hour (about 3 p.m.)

chronicle.hour.bein_haarbayim.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of twilight, literally 'between the evenings' (about 5:30 p.m.)

chronicle.hour.erev.note: Hebrew name, transliterated, of evening (about 6 p.m.)

chronicle.hour.middle_watch.note: The middle watch of the night (about 10 p.m.)
